post.summary:
`POST /engines/{id}/catalogs/{cid}/test` — "test connection": runs
`SHOW SCHEMAS FROM "<catalog>"` against the engine's Trino coordinator via
the native-monitor coordinator proxy ([`crate::monitor::coordinator_call`],
same service name + auth headers as query monitoring) and reports whether
the query reaches `FINISHED`. Submits `POST /v1/statement`, then follows
`nextUri` (GET) until a terminal state, an `error` object, or
[`CATALOG_TEST_MAX_POLLS`] iterations are exhausted (→ `ok:false`,
"timed out"). Never returns a transport/coordinator-shape failure as an
HTTP error status — those map to `ok:false` with an explanatory message —
EXCEPT when the coordinator itself is unreachable or kubernetes isn't
configured, which surface as the usual `CpError` (mirrors the other
coordinator-proxied routes in this file and in `monitor.rs`).

200.description: Test-connection result (ok=false with a message on a coordinator/query failure)

404.description: No such engine or catalog (or catalog not on this engine)

200.description: Cluster summary: running/queued/blocked query tallies + node list

404.description: No such engine

get.summary:
`GET /engines/{id}/pods/{pod}/exec` — upgrades to a WebSocket and bridges it
to a `/bin/sh` session inside the pod via `KubeClient::exec`. Same
ownership guard as [`pod_logs`]: the pod must be one of the engine's live
pods, checked BEFORE the WS upgrade so an unknown pod 404s instead of
upgrading and failing inside the socket.

parameters.name: pod
parameters.description: Pod name (must belong to the engine)

101.description: WebSocket upgrade bridging an interactive exec session in the pod

404.description: No such engine, or pod does not belong to the engine

get.summary:
`GET /engines/{id}/pods/{pod}/logs?tail=&previous=&container=` — bounded tail
of a pod's logs. The pod must belong to the engine (verified against the live
pod list from `EngineProvisioner::status`), so one platform admin can't read
an arbitrary pod's logs by guessing a name.

parameters.name: pod
parameters.description: Pod name (must belong to the engine)

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: Container name (defaults to the pod's main container)

200.description: Bounded tail of the pod's logs

400.description: Kubernetes not configured or log read failed

404.description: No such engine, or pod does not belong to the engine

get.summary:
`GET /engines/{id}/pods/{pod}/logs/follow?tail=` — upgrades to a WebSocket
and streams the pod's logs as they arrive (`kubectl logs -f` equivalent),
a ONE-directional stream (pod -> browser), unlike [`pod_exec`]'s
bidirectional bridge. Same ownership guard as [`pod_logs`]/[`pod_exec`]:
the pod must be one of the engine's live pods, checked BEFORE the WS
upgrade so an unknown pod 404s instead of upgrading and failing inside
the socket.

parameters.name: pod
parameters.description: Pod name (must belong to the engine)

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: Number of trailing lines to backfill (1..=5000, default 1000)

post.description:
Missing `kind` defaults to "access" (see `editor_to_ranger_json`), so the
P2 editor form — which never sent `kind` — stays wire-compatible.

The request body is one of the editor input unions — `AccessPolicyInput`
(the default when `kind` is absent), `MaskingPolicyInput`, or
`RowFilterPolicyInput` — dispatched on `kind`; documented as a free-form
object since the handler accepts any of the three shapes.

post.summary:
Object-scoped on the DASHBOARD: a `dashboard:read` object grant TRANSITIVELY
authorizes running the data of any card on that dashboard — NO per-chart
grant is needed. The card must belong to the path dashboard (else 404). Runs
the card chart's persisted query, optionally merged with resolved
dashboard-parameter filters from the request body, so a shared viewer can
view the card's (filtered) data without any `query:run` permission.
post.description:
The body is OPTIONAL (a body-less call runs the saved query unfiltered).
Incoming filters are appended to the persisted `spec.filters` and validated by
`compile_chart_sql` → `chartquery::build`, which resolves every filter `col`
against the dataset's real columns (an unknown column → 400) and renders the
values/operators through the injection-safe `sql_literal`/`FilterOp` path. The
client cannot inject a predicate on an arbitrary column.

CardRunBody.description:
Optional body for the card-data endpoint: resolved dashboard-parameter filters
to merge into the card chart's persisted query. Reuses `chartquery::Filter`
(the same `{ col, op, value }` shape the chart spec uses), so the frontend
sends exactly what `applyParamsToChart` produces. Each filter's `col` is
validated against the dataset's real columns before it is applied (an unknown
column → 400), and the values/operators are rendered through the same
injection-safe `sql_literal`/`FilterOp` path as the persisted filters.

filters.description: Resolved, dashboard-param-derived filters to AND onto the card's saved query.

ChartDataBody.description:
Build-only data request: produce SQL for a dataset + QuerySpec; the client submits it
to the existing /queries endpoint and polls.

Stays in `egret-bi` (not the leaf contract crate): its `query_spec` field is the
`egret-bi`-local [`QuerySpec`] query builder, which references `egret-query-api`
and other in-crate types and so cannot move to the leaf.

ChartRunResponse.description:
A saved chart's query, executed: columns + row-major rows. Mirrors the first
two fields of `TabularResult` so the frontend consumes it like a query
result. Returned by the object-scoped `POST /charts/{id}/data` endpoint,
which runs ONLY the chart's persisted query (no client-supplied spec).

rows.description: Row-major cell values; each inner vec is one row aligned to `columns`.

ColumnMeta.description: One column's name + engine-reported type name.

impersonate.description:
Trino only: run each query as the logged-in user (X-Trino-User).
Requires Trino impersonation + Ranger. Default false.

trinoConfig.description:
Optional full per-role config surface, stored under `spec["trinoConfig"]`.
Wire shape: `{ queryMaxMemory, logLevel, configProperties, env,
coordinator{replicas, resources, heap, queryMaxMemoryPerNode,
additionalJvmConfig, probes}, worker{... , gracefulShutdown} }`. On create
the simple wizard fields seed this; `update` sends the full per-role block.

authzServiceId.description:
Link the new engine to an EXISTING Ranger profile (authz_services id).
When omitted, provisioning creates a fresh profile named after the engine.

CreateSecretInput.description: Request body for creating a global named secret.

CreatedPolicyId.description: Doc-only mirror of the `{ "id": <n> }` body the create/update handlers return.

Database.description:
A full database registration row (no secret material).

`Serialize`/`Deserialize` are forward-looking contract surface: today the
wire type is the separate `DatabaseDetailDto` and the store builds `Database`
field-by-field from sqlx rows, so these codecs are not yet exercised — they
let a future out-of-process query-seam client exchange this domain type.

DatabaseInput.description:
Register/update body. Credentials are a NAMED secret (Epic B): either
`new_secret` (mint a new named secret inline) or `secret_id` (reference an
existing named secret in the workspace). Omitting both registers a connection
with no secret (or, on update, keeps the existing one).

DatabaseListDto.description: Minimal listing for the Explorer DB picker (no connection internals).

DatasetDataBody.description:
Body of the object-scoped dataset data-preview: an OPTIONAL row cap only.
There is deliberately NO client SQL field — the endpoint always runs
`SELECT * FROM <the dataset's own source>`, so a shared reader can preview
only the dataset its grant covers. Unknown fields are ignored.

limit.description: Rows to preview. Clamped to [100, 1000]; defaults to 200 when absent.

seconds.description: Soft-delete retention in seconds; null = hard delete.

DiscoveryDoc.description:
OIDC discovery document served at `/.well-known/openid-configuration` so the
embedded lakekeeper can locate this IdP's JWKS + token endpoint. Doc-only
mirror of the `serde_json::Value` the handler builds.

EngineCatalogDetailDto.description:
`GET /engines/{id}/catalogs/{cid}` payload: full stored config + secretRef,
with system-minted secret material redacted (see [`redact_catalog_config`]).

EngineDetailDto.description: `GET /engines/{id}` payload: the engine row flattened with live status.

EngineOption.description: An engine (DB connection) option shown in notebook settings.

enabled.description: Whether this engine is currently enabled for notebooks in this workspace.

EngineSpecDto.description:
The provisioning parameters surfaced back to clients (subset of the stored
`spec` jsonb; internal bookkeeping keys are ignored on deserialize).

trinoConfig.description: Surfaced back so the UI can prefill the config editor on reload.

ErrorBody.description:
The JSON body every error response carries: `{ "error": "<message>" }`.

This is the OpenAPI schema counterpart of the body produced by
`IntoResponse for Error` above — the single shape returned for every 4xx/5xx
across the API. Handlers reference it in their `#[utoipa::path]`
`responses(...)` for the error statuses. 5xx messages are redacted to
`"internal error"`; client-facing errors pass their `Display` message.

value.description:
Comparison operand. Scalar for most operators; a JSON array for `in`/`not_in`;
ignored for `is_null`/`is_not_null`. Validated against the column's generic type.

JwksDoc.description:
JWK set served at `/.well-known/jwks.json`. Doc-only mirror of the
`serde_json::Value` the handler builds; each key is a raw RFC 7517 JWK.

KernelStatus.description:
Public snapshot of a kernel: phase + gateway URL.

Serializes as `{ "phase": "ready", "url": "http://..." }`.

phase.description:
Lifecycle phase, serialized as a lowercase string
(`spawning` / `ready` / `dead`).

NewSecret.description:
Request shape for creating a brand-new named secret inline while registering a
connection (storage or database): `{ "name": ..., "value": ... }`. The value
is plaintext, accepted only on write and never returned. Shared across the
HTTP layers so each connection type can mint a named secret in one request.

value.description: Plaintext secret value; accepted only on write, never returned.

NotebookRuntime.description:
Full kernel manifest returned by `GET /ws/{workspace}/notebook-runtime` and
consumed by `egret-kernel` to build the kernel process environment.

username.description: The caller's stable username (email local-part, collision-suffixed).

engines.description: Workspace engines (DB connections) enabled for notebooks.

engine_jwt.description:
Short-lived per-user engine JWT the kernel presents to query engines.
`None` when the caller has no stored refresh token (e.g. password/local
users or OIDC logins without an offline token) — minting is best-effort
since no P1 engine consumes this yet.

engine_jwt_expires_at.description:
Expiry of `engine_jwt` (RFC3339); kernels re-mint before this time.
`None` whenever `engine_jwt` is `None`.

NotebookSetFolder.description:
Body for `PATCH /notebooks/{id}/folder`: move a notebook into a folder
(or back to Uncategorized with `folder_id: null`).

Renamed in the OpenAPI doc to `NotebookSetFolder` to avoid a global schema
collision with `egret_analytics_api::bi::SetFolder` (the BI seam's identically
named body); the wire shape is unchanged.

NotebookSummary.description: Summary view of a notebook (no cells). Used by ownership/IDOR gates.

bookmarked.description: Whether the requesting viewer has bookmarked this notebook.

folder_id.description: Folder this notebook lives in; `None` = Uncategorized.

ObjectGrantBody.description: Body of a share grant: give `principal` a workspace `role` on this object.

ObjectGrantDto.description: A single object-scoped grant on the object.

PolicySummary.description: Flattened, UI-facing view of one stored Ranger policy.

Principal.description: One egret identity offered by the policy picker.

name.description: The value written into the policy (user email / group name).

ProfileDto.description: A profile (Ranger service) + the engine(s) that link to it.

temporal_units.description:
dimension column name -> temporal unit token (snake_case, e.g. "month", "day_of_week").
Empty (default) = no truncation = legacy behavior.

QueryStatusDto.description: Full status view (preview inline; full result via the results endpoint).

columns.description: Column metadata `[{name,type}]`; `null` until the query finishes.

preview.description: Inline preview rows (bounded, row-major); `null` until the query finishes.

RangerErrorBody.description:
Doc-only mirror of the Ranger error envelope (`{ msg, statusCode }`), which
differs from the control-plane `ErrorBody` shape.

RangerServiceDefs.description: Doc-only mirror of the `{ "serviceDefs": [...] }` envelope `list_defs` returns.

serviceDefs.description: Each element is a raw Ranger service-definition object (stored verbatim).

RangerServicePolicies.description:
Doc-only mirror of the `ServicePolicies` plugin download envelope
(`egret-policy-api`) returned by `download_policies`.

policies.description: The service's enabled policies, each a raw Ranger policy object.

RangerServiceTags.description: Doc-only mirror of the empty `ServiceTags` payload returned by `download_tags`.

tags.description: Tag map keyed by tag-id (empty this phase).

ResultsPage.description: A page of the full result.

rows.description: Row-major cell values; each element is one row (a JSON array).

parentRoleId.description:
The role this one inherits permissions from (same scope). `None` at the
top of a chain.

inheritedPermissions.description:
Effective-minus-own permissions, for read-only display. Populated on the
single-role GET; empty on the list endpoint.

SchemaColumn.description: A single column in a DESCRIBE result.

SecretDto.description: Response DTO mirroring `WorkspaceSecretMeta` (never exposes the plaintext).

SeedResult.description: Doc-only mirror of the `{ "created": <n> }` body `seed_defaults` returns.

created.description: How many default policies were created (0 if the profile already had any).

StorageDto.description: Response DTO for a storage connection.

StorageInput.description:
Request body for creating/updating a global storage connection. A `new_secret`
takes precedence over a provided `secret_ref`: it mints a new global named
secret and binds the connection to it.

oneOf.description: Mint a new global named secret inline and use it as `secret_ref`.

TabularResult.description:
A fully-collected, in-memory query result (bounded by the caller's row limit).

`Serialize`/`Deserialize` are for the E4b contract crate + BI forwarding this
result directly across the seam boundary; today the store persists `columns`
and `rows` individually, so the whole-struct codecs are not yet exercised.

rows.description: Row-major cell values; each inner vec is one row aligned to `columns`.

TestInput.description: Body for testing an unsaved connection (no `name`).

UpdateCatalogBody.description:
`PUT /engines/{id}/catalogs/{cid}` body: replaces the stored `config` +
`secret_ref` in full (not a partial patch).

UpdateSecretInput.description:
Request body for updating a global named secret. Any subset may be present:
a `name` triggers a rename (re-describing with `description`); a `value`
rotates the underlying vault row.
